description: This App is installed via automation.DO NOT DELETE since its shared.

children.name: AWS Elastic Load Balancing ULM - Classic - 4XX and 5XX Code Analysis
children.description: See the details of the Classic ELB error status codes by client location, path, domain, and IPs.

panels.name: Log - 4XX ELB Status by Client Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/ELB* 
| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol
| parse field=request "* *://*:*/* HTTP" as method, protocol, domain, server_port, path nodrop
| parse field=client "*:*" as clientIP, port nodrop
| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop
| fields - request, client, backend
| where (elb_status_code matches "4*")
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = clientIP
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

panels.name: Log - 5XX ELB Status by Client Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/ELB* 
| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol
| parse field=request "* *://*:*/* HTTP" as method, protocol, domain, server_port, path nodrop
| parse field=client "*:*" as clientIP, port nodrop
| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop
| fields - request, client, backend
| where (elb_status_code matches "5*")
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = clientIP
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

panels.name: Log - Backend Status by Path
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/ELB* 
| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol
| parse field=request "* *://*:*/* HTTP" as method, protocol, domain, server_port, path nodrop
| parse field=client "*:*" as clientIP, port nodrop
| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop
| fields - request, client, backend
| where (backend_status_code matches "5*") or (backend_status_code matches "4*") 
| if (backend_status_code matches "5*",1,0) as backend_5XX
| if (backend_status_code matches "4*",1,0) as backend_4XX
| sum(backend_4XX) as backend_4XX, sum(backend_5XX) as backend_5XX by path
| limit 20
| sort by backend_5XX

panels.name: Log - Top 20 Client IPs

| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol

| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop

panels.name: Log - HTTP 5XX Count Outlier by Backend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/ELB* 
| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol
| parse field=request "* *://*:*/* HTTP" as method, protocol, domain, server_port, path nodrop
| parse field=client "*:*" as clientIP, port nodrop
| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop
| fields - request, client, backend
| where (backend_status_code matches "5*") 
| timeslice 1m
| count by backendIP, _timeslice
| outlier _count by backendIP  
| fields _timeslice,backendIP, _count_violation
| transpose row _timeslice column backendIP

panels.name: Log - Max and Average Total Client Latency by Backend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/ELB* 
| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol
| parse field=request "* *://*:*/* HTTP" as method, protocol, domain, server_port, path nodrop
| parse field=client "*:*" as clientIP, port nodrop
| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop
| (request_processing_time+backend_processing_time+response_processing_time) as client_latency
// Need to filter out logs where request_processing_time, target_processing_time, or response_processing_time are -1
// This means the load balancer can't dispatch the request to a target
| where !(request_processing_time=-1 OR backend_processing_time=-1 OR response_processing_time=-1)
| avg(client_latency) as avg_client_latency, max(client_latency) as max_client_latency by  backendIP
| order by max_client_latency

panels.name: Log - Outlier (Decrease) Requests  by Backend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/ELB*   
| parse "* * * * * * * * * * * \"*\" \"*\" * *" as datetime, loadbalancername, client, backend, request_processing_time, backend_processing_time, response_processing_time, elb_status_code, backend_status_code, received_bytes, sent_bytes, request,user_agent,ssl_cipher,ssl_protocol
| parse field=request "* *://*:*/* HTTP" as method, protocol, domain, server_port, path nodrop
| parse field=client "*:*" as clientIP, port nodrop
| parse field=backend "*:*" as backendIP, backend_port nodrop
| fields - request, client, backend
// Parse all fields above, then aggregate
| timeslice 1m 
| count by _timeslice,backendIP
| outlier _count by backendIP threshold=3,direction=- 
| where (_count_violation=1) and (_count_indicator=1)
| fields _timeslice, backendIP, _count 
| transpose row _timeslice column backendIP
